item.title: AgiBot WITA-Omni Full-Modal Model Tops DailyOmni Global Leaderboard: Beating Google Gemini, ByteDance Doubao, and Alibaba Qwen at Embodied Cross-Modal Understanding
item.description: AgiBot WITA-Omni scores 85.21 on DailyOmni benchmark, 6 of 8 indicators first place, using Thinker-Talker-Actor architecture that synchronizes speech, action, and expression on a single timeline.

item.title: Chinese Robots Begin Restructuring the Global Supply Chain as TIANZHIHANG Attempts Reverse Integration From Surgical Robots to Orthopedic Implants and Overseas Markets

item.title: Same Day Jensen Huang Champions Open Source, Ant Bailing Releases 124B Ling-3.0-flash Execution Model: Beating 1T-Ring-2.6 in 11 of 12 Benchmarks at 12% the Parameters

item.title: ByteDance and Alibaba Couldn't Stop It: Tencent WorkBuddy Quietly Took the AI Office Agent Top Spot in Four Months With 20.97 Million Monthly Visits

item.title: Domestic Chinese LLMs Too Expensive for Heavy Users: Per-Token Cost Advantage Vanishes When Real Development Workflows Reach Tens of Billions of Tokens Daily
